name: Nlpm
description: NLPM lints, scores, fixes, and trend-tracks the natural-language artifacts that make up a Claude Code plugin — skills, agents, commands, rules, hooks, manifests — against a 50-rule rubric on a 100-point scale. Ships focused agents (scanner, scorer, checker, fixer, tester, security-scanner, vague-scanner, vocab-drift-scanner) and a standalone Python validator (bin/nlpm-check) that runs in pre-commit hooks and CI without Claude Code installed, plus a shields.io "Validated by NLPM" badge.
longDescription:
Ships **8 agents**, **12 commands** and **1 hook**.

- **Agents** (8): `checker` (Cross-artifact consistency checker for NL programming artifacts), `scanner` (Discover and classify all NL programming artifacts in a repository), `scorer` (Scores NL programming artifacts on a 100-point scale using deterministic penalties), `security-scanner` (Scan NL programming plugins (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Antigravity) for security risks in executable artifacts: hooks, scripts, MCP…), `spec-researcher` (Researches one tool's CURRENT official documentation and diffs it against an nlpm convention overlay, returning a structured gap…), `tester` (Evaluate NL artifacts against test specifications), `vague-scanner` (Mechanical scanner for vague quantifier words in NL artifacts), `vocab-drift-scanner` (Scans NL programming artifacts for vocabulary drift — same concept named differently across files — without requiring a…)
- **Commands** (12): `check` (Check cross-artifact consistency — reference integrity, orphans, contradictions), `fix` (Auto-fix fixable findings in NL artifacts — missing fields, heading gaps, field renames), `init` (Prepare NLPM for this project — detect artifacts, set strictness, capture baseline trend snapshot), `ls` (Discover all natural language programming artifacts in a repository), `report` (Render a self-contained HTML report — per-file scores, score trend, cross-artifact graph, vocabulary noun-verb map, drift candidates, and…), `score` (Score NL programming artifacts — 100-point quality score per file), `security-scan` (Scan a Claude Code plugin for security risks in executable artifacts (hooks, scripts, MCP configs, dependencies)), `spec-sync` (Sync nlpm's convention overlays with the latest official Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity specs — research upstream…), and 4 more
- **Hooks** (1): `PostToolUse`

Installs with `claude plugin install nlpm@claude-community` from `xiaolai/nlpm-for-claude`.
